items.title: Bank Of America (BAC) Agrees To Settle Unauthorized Account Openings Class Action
items.summary: Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) has agreed to settle a class-action lawsuit over allegedly unauthorized customer account openings. The agreement resolves claims that the bank opened accounts without proper customer consent, mirroring issues previously seen at other large lenders. Settlement terms are subject to court approval, with affected customers expected to receive compensation through a claims process.
